metadata.system: Thunder-Forged crafting — multi-tier weapon/armor choice-slot (Tier 1/2/3, one pick per tier)
metadata.status: SHELVED — out of endgame scope. Machinery complete; pools intentionally empty.
metadata.harvest_finding: Confirmed at the wiki (2026-07-28, KTD3): there is NO 'Legendary Thunder-Forged' — the wiki search returns 0 hits, and the actual page 'Thunder-Forged' (https://ddowiki.com/page/Thunder-Forged) documents an Update 21 EPIC system: base ML22, Tier 1 ML24, Tier 2 ML26, Tier 3 ML28. It caps at ML28, below the optimizer's ML30-36 endgame band. The gear-planner catalog carries 43 Thunder-Forged shells, ALL ML22 (0 at ML>=29), so U3's Legendary-only host filter marks zero hosts. Mechanically the tier menus are overwhelmingly procs / on-hit / dragon-breath clickies / caster 'Dwarvencraft' lines (spell power, spell DC, spell-crit Lore); only a curated minority are clean (stat,bonus_type,int) tuples. Feature parked under the endgame-BiS scope: no Legendary version exists and no Legendary hosts to attach to. Re-scoping to Epic ML22-28 coverage is possible but off the original 'endgame BiS' driver.
metadata.tier_structure_confirmed: 3 tiers, weapons ML24/26/28, 'choose one upgrade per tier' — matches the multi-tier choice-slot model if ever harvested for Epic scope.
